summary:
Clean. Visual browser verification wasn't possible in this sandbox (the headless screenshot tool returns a blank page for `localhost` dev/preview servers regardless of content — likely a network-proxy restriction, not an app error), but lint, build, and the full test suite (143 tests) all pass, including new tests exercising the Login form and sidebar links.

## Summary

- Added `src/pages/LoginPage.jsx`: a dark-themed sign-in form matching the existing page styling, showing the session-expired message `DashboardPage` already passes via `navigate('/login', { state: { message } })`. Since no login/auth endpoint exists in any module's contract (the HTTP client explicitly notes there's no login flow yet, only dev headers), this gates entry client-side and routes to `/` on submit rather than inventing a backend call.
- Added `src/shared/components/SidebarNav.jsx` and `src/shared/components/AppLayout.jsx`: a responsive sidebar (static column on `md+`, off-canvas drawer with hamburger toggle below that) linking to all existing routed screens, grouped into Workspace/Settings sections.
- Wired `/login` route and wrapped the rest of the routes in `AppLayout` in `src/App.jsx`; the external-facing `/negotiation/external/:linkToken` and `/sign/:sessionId` routes stay outside the layout since those are unauthenticated third-party pages.
- Added tests: `src/__tests__/LoginPage.test.jsx` and `src/shared/components/SidebarNav.test.jsx`.
blockers: Not applied -- Backend authentication for the Login form: no login/auth endpoint exists in any module contract in CLAUDE.md, and the backend repo isn't visible here — the form is a client-side gate only, per the existing dev-header placeholder note in services/http.js

visual_check.evidence: verifier did not return parseable JSON

context_sharing.notes: No API calls appear in any of these six files. LoginPage.jsx is explicitly a client-side-only gate (per its own comment) that navigates to '/' on non-empty submit without calling a backend auth endpoint. App.jsx only defines react-router-dom routes, AppLayout.jsx and SidebarNav.jsx only render layout/nav UI, and both test files only exercise rendering/navigation behavior — none import src/services/http.ts or any service module.
